load_osm_data_from_file: load OpenStreetMap data from a JSON or XML file into an OSMData object
parse_osm_nodes_from_dict: parse OSM nodes from an Overpass-like dictionary structure using OSMNode.from_dict
parse_osm_ways_from_dict: parse OSM ways from an Overpass-like dictionary structure using OSMWay.from_dict
get_length_from_osm_tag: get a length value in meters from an OSM element tag using get_length
project_osm_nodes_to_xy: project all OSM node geo coordinates to XY using add_xy_to_nodes with a Projection
